item.title: How a novel set in Taiwan sparked a cultural reckoning
item.description: Taiwan Travelogue is a novel exploring a journey through 1930s Taiwan under Japanese colonial rule. Today, it's prompting a fresh look at the island's complex history and identity.

item.description: Tadej Pogacar has won the Tour de France. He's so good, some can't help but wonder if he's the greatest of all time.

item.title: Remembering the Sand Creek Massacre through one objector's letters
item.description: In 1864, Captain Silas Soule of the 1st Colorado Cavalry refused orders to kill innocent Native Americans. He wrote letters about the massacre, which may have changed the course of history.

item.title: Climate change is now threatening a pillar of childhood: summer break
item.description: When summer rolls around, many parents scramble to sign up their young kids for outdoor activities. But what do you do when extreme heat and wildfire smoke increasingly make the outdoors dangerous?
